title: Evaluation tensor splitting for the actual finite constant field
statement: For a finite-field datum D of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], and m >= 1, the tensor-splitting clause of [def-zl-constant-extension-sheet-heart-data] holds: with the specified algebra structure on E = D.extensionSubfield m hm, there is a ring isomorphism E tensor_(D.k_0) D.k to the product of D.k indexed by D.k_0-algebra embeddings sigma:E -> D.k, taking t tensor b to (sigma(t)b)_sigma, and the number of embeddings is m. The chosen subfield and its cardinality are those of [def-dl-a1-constant-extension-data].

proof.text: Use constantExtensionField_properties of [def-dl-a1-constant-extension-data] to give E its finite type. The equality of finite cardinalities q^[E:k_0] = #E = q^m and q >= 2 give [E:k_0] = m. The finite-field separability assertion of [lem-sfb-finite-field-galois-frobenius] applies. Define f:k tensor_(k_0) E -> product_sigma k by b tensor t mapping to (b sigma(t))_sigma. Distinct embeddings are linearly independent as multiplicative characters (Mathlib linearIndependent_monoidHom); span_flip_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent makes the evaluation vectors span the product. Each such vector is f(1 tensor t), so f is surjective. The source dimension is [E:k_0] by finrank_baseChange; the target dimension is the number of embeddings, also [E:k_0] by AlgHom.card for a separable extension into an algebraically closed field. Equal dimensions make f injective. Package f as an algebra equivalence and compose its underlying ring equivalence with the tensor swap. Commutativity gives the prescribed evaluation formula and the degree calculation gives exactly m embeddings.

Existing separable_tensor_algebraicallyClosed_equiv_pi has no pinned evaluation formula. No duplicate of this finite constant-field clause.
